recordExtractor.source: ({ helpers, $ }) => { const records = helpers.docsearch({ recordProps: { lvl1: [".content h1", "head > title"], content: [".content p, .content li"], lvl0: { selectors: "#algoliaSectionTitle", defaultValue: "Documentation" }, lvl2: [".content h2"], lvl3: [".content h3"], lvl4: [".content h4"], pageRank: "90" }, aggregateContent: true }); const normalize = s => s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const canonical = t => t.toLowerCase().replace(/^(@|--?)/, ''); const keywords = $('#algoliaSearchKeywords').text(); const keywordTerms = keywords.split(',').map(k => canonical(normalize(k))).filter(k => k !== ''); if (keywords) { records.forEach(r => { r.searchKeywords = keywords; }); } const escape = s => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); const elements = $('.content p, .content li, .content h2, .content h3, .content h4').map((i, el) => ({ id: $(el).attr('id'), text: normalize($(el).text()), codes: $(el).find('code').filter((j, code) => $(code).closest('pre').length === 0).map((j, code) => normalize($(code).text()).toLowerCase()).get().filter(t => t.length >= 2 && t.length <= 60) })).get().filter(e => e.text !== ''); const pageCodes = [...new Set(elements.flatMap(e => e.codes))].map(code => ({ term: canonical(code), regex: new RegExp('(^|[^\\w@$-])' + escape(code) + '(?![\\w-])') })); records.forEach(r => { const terms = new Set(keywordTerms); const text = normalize((r.type === 'content' ? r.content : r.hierarchy[r.type]) || ''); if (text !== '' && r.type === 'content') { elements.forEach(e => { if (e.codes.length > 0 && text.includes(e.text)) { e.codes.forEach(code => terms.add(canonical(code))); } }); } else if (text !== '') { const heading = text.toLowerCase(); pageCodes.forEach(c => { if (c.regex.test(heading)) { terms.add(c.term); } }); } if (terms.size > 0) { r.boostTerms = [...terms]; } }); return records; }
